name: whiteboard
description: Production-oriented monorepo foundation for a real-time 3D collaborative whiteboard.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @whiteboard/shared && npm run build -w @whiteboard/api && npm run build -w @whiteboard/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @whiteboard/web && npm run lint -w @whiteboard/api && npm run lint -w @whiteboard/shared
scripts.test: npm run test -w @whiteboard/shared && npm run test -w @whiteboard/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @whiteboard/shared && npm run typecheck -w @whiteboard/api && npm run typecheck -w @whiteboard/web
